title: Document reader
about: Reads Word and PDF files in the folders you allow and hands the model their text, in pieces when it is long.

env.TW_DOCS_ROOTS: The folders it may read, one after the other, separated by ; on Windows and by : elsewhere.
env.TW_DOCS_MAX_BYTES: The largest file it reads, in bytes. Without it: 52428800 (50 MB).
env.TW_DOCS_MAX_PAGES: The most pages of a PDF it reads. Without it: 500.
